text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world at a remarkable speed, but its growth brings serious ethical questions. One major concern is bias: because AI learns from data created by humans, it can repeat or even worsen existing prejudices, for example in hiring or lending decisions. This makes fairness essential—we must ensure that these systems treat all people equally. Another issue is privacy. AI often needs vast amounts of personal information, so protecting that data is critical. Transparency also matters; people should understand how decisions are made. Finally, responsible AI development means that companies and governments must take accountability for the technology they create. By focusing on these principles, we can build AI that truly benefits society.
